content.title: NFL Draft 2026 - Draft Experience Hours of Operation
content.text: 2026 NFL Draft | Registration | NFL.com April 23 – 25 | FREE ENTRY NFL Draft Experience The ultimate FREE football event with entertainment for all ages! Experience photos with the Vince Lombardi Trophy and Super Bowl Rings, interactive games and NFL FLAG clinics, star player and legend autographs, live music entertainment and local cuisine. VIP Ticket Packages Featuring the best seats to watch the action unfold, hospitality with elevated tailgate fare, beer and wine, NFL player appearances, the chance for behind-the-scenes tours and more, your trip to the 2026 NFL Draft will be memorable for years to come. Pittsburgh, PA unlocks the perfect backdrop for fans to witness future NFL stars find their new teams and participate in the NFL's ultimate fan festival at Draft Experience. Featured highlights include: Future Stars Take the Stage All 7 rounds of the NFL Draft announced LIVE at the Draft Theater NFL FLAG Clinics in Titletown Several NFL Play60 flag football clinics throughout Draft Week Player & Legend Autographs Meet and green opportunities with current NFL players and legends NFL Exhibits & Photo Ops Vince Lombardi Trophy, Super Bowl Rings, and more Interactive Games Run the 40 yard dash, kick a field goal, and compete in catching drills. Live Music & Entertainment Enjoy all-day entertainment and local performances. Shop NFL Merchandise Officially licensed apparel & merchandise for all 32 teams Legendary Acrisure Stadium Experience the iconic football stadium at the heart of the Draft NFL DRAFT EXPERIENCE - HOURS OF OPERATION
